transcript.statement: The proposed requirements ensure that the bookkeeping system adheres to ethical and compliance standards. RES-01 guarantees compliance with financial regulations, RES-02 ensures only authorized personnel can modify transactions, and RES-03 maintains a transparent audit trail. Additionally, RES-04 provides mechanisms to detect fraud, RES-05 ensures fairness in reporting, RES-06 allows for confidential reporting of ethical concerns, and RES-07 supports multi-currency transactions with transparent exchange rates. These requirements are essential for maintaining accountability and trust in the system.

transcript.statement: Safety is paramount in a bookkeeping system. SAF-01 ensures accurate transaction recording to prevent data loss, while SAF-02 enforces double-entry principles to maintain integrity. SAF-03 mandates a 7-year audit trail for accountability. SAF-04 introduces error handling for fault tolerance, and SAF-05 guarantees safe degradation during outages so users can access essential functions. SAF-06 ensures accurate currency conversion validations, and SAF-07 mandates regular backups to avoid data loss. Each requirement supports a robust, reliable system necessary for users' financial safety.

transcript.statement: Trustworthiness is crucial for a bookkeeping system as it ensures data protection and integrity. TRU-01 mandates encryption for all transactions to safeguard sensitive information. TRU-02 establishes role-based access control to prevent unauthorized access. TRU-03 requires an immutable audit trail for accountability, while TRU-04 validates data input to prevent malicious entries. TRU-05 enforces two-factor authentication, enhancing security. TRU-06 logs user access, ensuring transparency, and TRU-07 restricts data access based on roles, maintaining confidentiality. Together, these requirements form a comprehensive security framework essential for user trust and compliance.

transcript.statement: Performance efficiency is crucial for a bookkeeping system to ensure a seamless user experience. EFF-01 guarantees quick processing of transactions to optimize responsiveness, while EFF-02 allows concurrent processing for multiple users, enhancing throughput. EFF-03 focuses on minimizing memory usage, optimizing resource utilization. EFF-04 ensures timely generation of financial reports, and EFF-05 implements caching to reduce latency for frequently accessed data. EFF-06 ensures quick currency conversion for real-time transactions, and EFF-07 mandates low logging delays for audit trails. Together, these requirements prioritize efficiency without compromising the system's integrity.

transcript.statement: Sustainability is essential in the development of the bookkeeping system. GRN-04 tracks resource impacts for continuous improvement, while GRN-05 provides users with sustainability reports to raise awareness. GRN-06 allows users to offset carbon emissions, and GRN-07 ensures compliance with sustainability regulations. Each requirement contributes to a greener future and aligns with global sustainability goals.

requirements.text: The system shall maintain an immutable audit trail for accountability and transparency.
The system shall ensure compliance with financial regulations and standards.
The system shall implement access control mechanisms to ensure data integrity and compliance.
The system shall ensure that all financial transactions are processed within 2 seconds.
The system shall support concurrent processing of at least 100 users.
The system shall provide error handling mechanisms to manage faults during transactions.
The system shall provide functionalities to detect potential financial discrepancies.
The system shall ensure accurate currency conversions during transactions.
The system shall maintain a transparent audit trail for all transactions.
The system shall minimize energy consumption during data processing.
The system shall implement cloud solutions to lower the carbon footprint.
The system shall support document digitization to reduce paper usage by at least 80%.
The system shall provide users with sustainability reports on energy consumption.
The system shall support two-factor authentication for secure access.
